lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots are arranged in a multi-row horizontal alignment beginning posterior to the fifth gill slit, with spot diameter and inter-centroid distance increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid of high-intensity nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, manifesting as linear boundaries with a high-contrast transition from high-luminance superior edges to shadowed inferior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) clustered around the ventral margin and the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
